_about: Synthetic call openings for the simulated call floor. Style follows real VANI transcripts (romanised Hinglish). The bot always introduces itself as IndiaMART's virtual assistant (decision D10). After a viewer barges in, the call continues live with Sarvam.

91000101.text: Namaste Imran ji, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal bol rahi hoon. Maine dekha aapne Star Supplier package do baar dekha. Kya do minute baat ho sakti hai?
Haan boliye. Par pehle hi bata doon, abhi budget thoda tight hai.
Bilkul samajh sakti hoon. Price main phone pe nahi bataungi — bas yeh samajhna tha ki aapko zyada leads chahiye ya sahi leads?
Sahi leads. Pichli baar students ke calls aaye the, time waste hua.
Yeh sunke afsos hua, aapka time keemti hai. Isliye hamare executive aapki category ke filter set karke dikhayenge.
Theek hai, 10 tareekh ke baad payment aata hai, tab baat karte hain.
Perfect. Toh 11 tareekh ko factory pe meeting rakh dein? Basni Industrial Area wala address sahi hai?

91000102.text: Namaskaram Lakshmi Narayana garu, nenu IndiaMART virtual assistant Payal. Meeru Lead Manager chustunnaru kada?
91000102.gloss: Hello sir, I'm Payal, IndiaMART's virtual assistant. You were looking at the Lead Manager?

91000102.text: Avunu, Karnataka leads kuda vastaya? Ela filter cheyali?
91000102.gloss: Yes, will I get Karnataka leads too? How do I filter?

91000102.text: Vastayi sir. State filter lo Karnataka add cheyochu. Mee sprayer category lo gata nela 64 buy leads vachayi.
91000102.gloss: Yes sir. You can add Karnataka in the state filter. Your sprayer category had 64 buy leads last month.
Interesting. Will you show a demo?

91000102.switch: Interest → go deeper, move to next step

91000102.text: Tappakunda. Mee Autonagar office ki executive vachi demo chupistaru. Repu sayantram 4 ki okay na?
91000102.gloss: Sure. An executive will come to your Autonagar office for a demo. Tomorrow 4 pm okay?

91000103.text: Hello Rohit, this is Payal, IndiaMART's virtual assistant. You just bought a 20-lead top-up — do you have two minutes?
I'm on the shop floor, make it quick.
One line: 18 of 20 leads used in 4 days. A monthly quota could save you top-ups. Call at 6 pm?
Fine, 6 pm. Send the pump housing buyers too.
Done — 6 pm with your executive. Thank you, Rohit.

91000104.text: Hello Meenakshi ji, this is Payal, IndiaMART's virtual assistant. You added 12 towel products today — great work!
Puriyala... English konjam kashtam. Tamil-la pesunga.
91000104.gloss: Didn't understand... English is a bit hard. Please speak in Tamil.

91000104.text: Sari amma. Neenga 12 towel products add pannirukeenga. Buyers ungala nera contact panna enquiry varum.
91000104.gloss: Sure ma'am. You added 12 towel products. When buyers contact you directly it comes as an enquiry.
What's the difference between buy lead and enquiry?

91000104.switch: Confusion → one idea at a time, simpler words

91000104.text: Enquiry ungalukku mattum varum. Buy lead IndiaMART-kku varum, neenga vaangalaam. Oru executive Tamil-la vilakkuvaanga.
91000104.gloss: An enquiry comes only to you. A buy lead comes to IndiaMART and you can pick it. An executive will explain in Tamil.

91000105.text: Namaste Farhan ji, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal. Aapne renewal page dekha—
Renewal? Pehle meri complaint ka kya hua? Callback ka promise kiya tha, kisi ne call nahi kiya!

91000105.switch: Frustration → acknowledge first, no pitch, warmth high

91000105.text: Aap bilkul sahi keh rahe hain, callback nahi hua — iske liye maafi chahti hoon. Main abhi aapki complaint senior executive ko escalate kar rahi hoon.
Theek hai. Mujhe sirf pharma companies ki leads chahiye, students ki nahi.
Note kar liya: sirf pharma buyers. Baddi wali enquiry aapke paas hai — executive kal 11 baje aapko call karenge?

91000106.text: Namaste Kavita ji, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal. Aap TrustSEAL ki document list dekh rahi thi?
Haan! Kitne din lagenge verification mein? Aur FSSAI chahiye kya?

91000106.switch: Interest → go deeper, move to next step

91000106.text: FSSAI aur GST dono kaam aayenge. Executive aapke Dhayari shop pe aake documents dekh lenge, process wahi samjha denge.
Chalega, Saturday ko aa sakte hain?
Saturday 12 baje fix kar deti hoon. Main aapko calendar invite aur address confirm bhej deti hoon.

91000107.text: Namaste Harish bhai, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal. Aapne renewal page dekha—
Dekho, Desai ji sab handle karte hain. Aap log baar baar call mat karo.

91000107.switch: Existing executive → do not pitch, hand off

91000107.text: Samajh gayi, Desai ji aapke account manager hain. Main unhe aapka message de deti hoon, aur aage se yeh call band.
Haan theek hai. Dubai wali enquiry Desai ji ko bata dena.
Zaroor, Dubai porcelain slab enquiry Desai ji tak pahuncha dungi. Dhanyavaad.

91000108.text: Namaste Sanjay ji, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal. Aapne naya LED product add kiya—
Haan kiya, par business slow hai. Paid kuch nahi lena.
Bilkul, main kuch bechne nahi aayi. Bas bata doon, Lucknow se 200 LED bulb ki PNS call aayi thi.
Achha? Woh number mila nahi mujhe.
Woh enquiry aapke account mein hai. Ek mahine baad dobara call karun, ya abhi app mein dikha doon?

91000109.text: Hello Anita ji, this is Payal, IndiaMART's virtual assistant. Your enquiries tripled this week — congratulations!
Thank you! But tell me, are there foreign buyers also on IndiaMART? How do they find me?
Yes, export buyers search on IndiaMART too. They find sellers through category search and listing priority.
Ektu bujhte parchhi na... priority mane ki?
91000109.gloss: I don't quite understand... what does priority mean?

91000109.text: Simple way: when a buyer searches 'Jamdani saree', sellers with priority appear first. An executive can show you live.

91000110.text: Khamma ghani Vikram Singh ji, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal. Aapne export package dekha—
Dekha, par doosre log isse kam mein le rahe hain. Aap logon ka rate zyada hai.
Main rate phone pe nahi bata sakti. Aapko kisne aur kitna bataya tha, woh confirm kar loon?
Kisi ne nahi bataya, suna hai. Muscat se ek container ki enquiry aayi hai.
Toh executive aapko export buyers ka data aur sahi plan dikha denge — RIICO Marble Area mein visit rakhein?

91000111.text: Hello Deepa, this is Payal, IndiaMART's virtual assistant. You viewed the Leader package — do you have—
I'm at the auction. One minute. What is it?
Hamburg buyer wants 2 tonnes cardamom. Leader puts you on top. Call after 2 pm?

91000112.text: Sat Sri Akal Gurpreet ji, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal. Aapki kuch buyer calls miss—
Roz roz IndiaMART se call aate hain, buyer ka ek call nahi aata! Pareshan ho gayi hoon.
Maafi chahti hoon, itne calls pareshan karte hain. Asal mein 8 buyers ne aapko call kiya tha — woh calls miss ho gayi.
Kya? Mujhe toh pata hi nahi. Kaise dekhun?

91000112.switch: Confusion → one step at a time

91000112.text: App mein 'PNS calls' kholiye, wahan Karnal wale buyer ka number hai. Executive aake setting bhi theek kar denge.

91000113.text: Hello Mohammed Arif, this is Payal, IndiaMART's virtual assistant. I saw you updated six rack products today.
Yes yes. Arey, Hindi mein baat karo na, aaram se samajh aata hai.
Bilkul Arif bhai. Shamshabad mein ek logistics company ko 120 racks chahiye — aapke heavy duty racks match karte hain.
Achha! Unse milna hai mujhe. Kab hoga?
Executive kal Balanagar aake details denge — 3 baje theek rahega?

91000114.text: Namaste Sneha ji, main IndiaMART ki virtual assistant Payal. Aapne buy-lead package dekha — kya do minute baat ho sakti hai?
Haan, par pehle sample leads dikhao. Bina dekhe paise nahi lagaungi.
Bilkul sahi baat. Bhopal ke ek caterer ko har mahine 50,000 cups chahiye — aisi leads executive dikha denge.
50,000 har mahine? Batao aur, kitne buyers hain aise?
Madhya Pradesh mein pichle mahine 9 lakh ki demand thi. Sanwer Road wale address pe meeting rakh dein?

turns.text: Namaste, IndiaMART Help Desk se main Payal bol rahi hoon, virtual assistant. Aapne Delhi Pneumatics ko call kiya tha — kya aapko industrial air compressor chahiye?
Haan ji, compressor chahiye factory ke liye.
Ji bilkul. Kitne compressor chahiye aapko?
Do chahiye, 10 HP wale.
Samajh gayi. Aapka shubh naam kya hai?
Ramesh Yadav.
Namaste, IndiaMART Help Desk se Payal, virtual assistant. Aap solar water heater ke liye call kar rahi thi?
Haan, 200 litre wala chahiye ghar ke liye.
Ji. Kitne units chahiye?
Ek hi.
Aap kis shehar se hain?
Nashik, Maharashtra.
Namaskaram, IndiaMART Help Desk nunchi Payal, virtual assistant. Meeku harvester spare parts kavali kada?
turns.gloss: Hello, Payal from IndiaMART Help Desk, virtual assistant. You need harvester spare parts?

turns.text: Avunu, cutter bar blades kavali.
turns.gloss: Yes, I need cutter bar blades.

turns.text: Entha quantity kavali?
Fifty pieces.
Namaste Neha ji, IndiaMART Help Desk se Payal. Aapki corrugated boxes ki requirement mili hai — kuch details confirm kar loon?
Haan boliye, jaldi.
Bas do sawal. Kitne boxes chahiye?
Adaab, IndiaMART Help Desk se Payal, virtual assistant. Aap chikan kurti ke liye call kar rahe the?
Ji, boutique ke liye wholesale chahiye.
Kitne piece chahiye?
Abhi 100 piece, baad mein aur.
Hello Priya, this is Payal from IndiaMART Help Desk, a virtual assistant. You were trying to reach BrewTech India about a coffee machine?
Yes, for my cafe. Is any seller available now?
Let me check sellers near Kochi. Which city and state are you in?
Kochi, Kerala.
Sat Sri Akal, IndiaMART Help Desk se Payal, virtual assistant. Aapko tractor tyre chahiye?
Kya? Kaun bol raha hai? Main toh seller ko call kar raha tha.
Ji, seller abhi uplabdh nahi the, isliye call yahan aayi. Main aapko doosre seller se jodne mein madad karungi. Kaun sa tyre chahiye?
Achha. 13.6-28 rear tyre, do.
Namaste, IndiaMART Help Desk se Payal, virtual assistant. Kya aapko biryani handi chahiye?
Haan, restaurant ke liye. Copper wali.
Ji. Kitni handi chahiye?
Chhe. Aur price kya hai?
